topic: Apple is developing a screenless, Whoop-style fitness tracker
details: Bloomberg report (Sept 22, 2026): Apple is building prototypes of a screenless fitness/health tracker - thin fabric band + sensor computing module, no display - to rival Whoop and Oura. Backed by Eddy Cue and Tim Cook but no green light yet; if approved, likely not before 2028.
